title: Volume Under a Paraboloid over a General Region
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the volume under z = x^2 + y^2 over the region between y = 2x and y = x^2.

steps.title: Find Intersection Points
steps.explanation: The curves intersect at (0, 0) and (2, 4). On [0, 2], 2x >= x^2.

steps.title: Integrate with Respect to y
steps.mathExpression: \int_{x^2}^{2x} (x^2 + y^2) \, dy = \left[ x^2 y + \frac{y^3}{3} \right]_{x^2}^{2x} = \left( 2x^3 + \frac{8x^3}{3} \right) - \left( x^4 + \frac{x^6}{3} \right) = \frac{14}{3}x^3 - x^4 - \frac{1}{3}x^6
steps.explanation: Evaluate inner antiderivative between parabola and line.
